034/**
035 * Basic implementation of {@link WritableBeanStore}.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * A simple storage database for beans keyed by type and name.
039 * Used to retrieve and instantiate beans using an injection-like API.
040 * It's similar in concept to the injection framework of Spring but greatly simplified in function and not intended to implement a full-fledged injection framework.
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * Beans can be stored with or without names.  Named beans are typically resolved using
044 * the <ja>@Name</ja> or <ja>@Qualified</ja> annotations on constructor or method parameters.
045 *
046 * <p>
047 * This implementation is thread-safe and supports parent bean stores for hierarchical bean resolution.
048 *
049 * <h2 class='section'>Resolution order:</h2>
050 * <p>
051 * Bean lookups consult the following sources in this order, returning the first match:
052 * <ol>
053 *    <li>{@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore,BeanStore) Overriding parent} (e.g. a Spring application context bridge), if non-{@code null}.
054 *    <li>Local entries added via {@link #addBean(Class,Object) addBean} / {@link #addSupplier(Class,Supplier) addSupplier}.
055 *    <li>Regular {@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore) parent}, if non-{@code null}.
056 *    <li>Local default suppliers added via {@link #addDefaultSupplier(Class,Supplier) addDefaultSupplier} (memoizer-backed framework defaults).
057 * </ol>
058 *
059 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
060 *    <li class='jc'>{@link BeanStore} - Read-only bean lookup interface
061 *    <li class='jc'>{@link WritableBeanStore} - Writable bean store interface
062 * </ul>
063 */
064@SuppressWarnings({
065   "java:S135", // @PreDestroy/@Bean discovery loops use per-element continue guards for clarity; refactoring obscures the per-annotation filter chain
066   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
067   "java:S3011", // setAccessible(true) is required to invoke private/package-private @Bean members and @PreDestroy methods via reflection
068   "java:S3776", // matchesConditions and registerConfiguration intentionally centralize the @Conditional/@Bean discovery state machine; splitting hurts cohesion
069   "resource", // BeanStore is a fluent AutoCloseable; self-returns and owned/sentinel stores are not new resources to close.
070   "unchecked" // Bean maps are keyed by Class<T>, so (T)/(Supplier<T>)/(Class<? extends T>) casts on stored suppliers and bindings match the requested bean type
071})
072public class BasicBeanStore implements WritableBeanStore {
073   private static final RichLogger LOGGER = RichLogger.getLogger(BasicBeanStore.class.getName());
074
075   /**
076    * Static reusable empty instance.
077    *
078    * <p>
079    * Useful as a placeholder when an API requires a {@link BeanStore} but the caller has no beans to
080    * register &mdash; e.g. as the parent argument to a builder that only needs the bean store for
081    * downstream parameter resolution.
082    *
083    * <p>
084    * <b>Treat this instance as read-only.</b>  It's typed as the concrete class so it can be passed
085    * to APIs that take {@link WritableBeanStore} or {@code BasicBeanStore}, but callers should not
086    * call any mutating methods on it &mdash; doing so would leak state between unrelated callers.
087    * Code that legitimately needs to add beans should construct its own {@code new BasicBeanStore()}.
088    */
089   public static final BasicBeanStore INSTANCE = new BasicBeanStore();
090
091   private final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,Supplier<?>>> entries;
092   private final BeanStore parent;
093   private final BeanStore overridingParent;
094   private final AtomicReference<StackOverlay> overlayStack = new AtomicReference<>();
095   private final AtomicReference<Extras> extras = new AtomicReference<>();
096   private final AtomicReference<Tracking> tracking = new AtomicReference<>();
097   private final AtomicBoolean closed = new AtomicBoolean();
098
099   /**
100    * Rarely-used state, created on first write so a short-lived store that only holds a few entries (e.g. one per
101    * request) doesn't allocate it.
102    */
103   private static final class Extras {
104      final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,Supplier<?>>> defaults = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
105      // Holds only non-default metadata (@Primary / @Order / priority); an absent entry means BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT.
106      final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,BeanSourceMeta>> entryMetadata = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
107      final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,Class<?>> typeBindings = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
108      final Set<Class<?>> registeredConfigurations = Collections.synchronizedSet(new HashSet<>());
109   }
110
111   /** Beans handed out by this store, in resolution order, for {@link #close()} callbacks.  Guarded by itself. */
112   private static final class Tracking {
113      final List<Object> beans = new ArrayList<>(4);
114      final Set<Object> identities = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>(8));
115   }
116
117   private Extras extras() {
118      var x = extras.get();
119      if (x == null) {
120         synchronized (this) {
121            x = extras.get();
122            if (x == null) {
123               x = new Extras();
124               extras.set(x);
125            }
126         }
127      }
128      return x;
129   }
130
131   private ConcurrentHashMap<String,Supplier<?>> defaultTypeMap(Class<?> beanType) {
132      var x = extras.get();
133      return x == null ? null : x.defaults.get(beanType);
134   }
135
136   private void putEntryMeta(Class<?> beanType, String key, BeanSourceMeta meta) {
137      if (meta == BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT) {
138         // Default metadata is represented by absence; drop any non-default value this key previously had.
139         var x = extras.get();
140         if (x != null) {
141            var m = x.entryMetadata.get(beanType);
142            if (m != null)
143               m.remove(key);
144         }
145      } else {
146         extras().entryMetadata.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).put(key, meta);
147      }
148   }

150   /**
151    * No-arg constructor.  Equivalent to {@code new BasicBeanStore(null)}.
152    *
153    * <p>
154    * Creates a standalone, parent-less bean store.  All lookups consult only locally-registered beans and
155    * default suppliers.
156    */
157   public BasicBeanStore() {
158      this(null, null);
159   }
160
161   /**
162    * Constructor.
163    *
164    * @param parent The parent bean store.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.  Bean searches are performed recursively up this parent chain
165    *    <i>after</i> local entries are checked.
166    */
167   public BasicBeanStore(BeanStore parent) {
168      this(parent, null);
169   }
170
171   /**
172    * Constructor that accepts an overriding parent bean store.
173    *
174    * <p>
175    * The {@code overridingParent} is consulted <i>before</i> any local entries during bean lookup, allowing an outer
176    * scope (typically a Spring {@code ApplicationContext} bridge) to take precedence over local registrations.  The
177    * regular {@code parent} continues to be consulted as a fallback after local entries.
178    *
179    * <p>
180    * Final resolution order:
181    * <ol>
182    *    <li>{@code overridingParent} (if non-{@code null})
183    *    <li>local entries (added via {@link #addBean(Class,Object) addBean} / {@link #addSupplier(Class,Supplier) addSupplier})
184    *    <li>regular {@code parent} (if non-{@code null})
185    *    <li>local default suppliers (added via {@link #addDefaultSupplier(Class,Supplier) addDefaultSupplier})
186    * </ol>
187    *
188    * @param parent The parent bean store, used as a fallback after local entries.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (this store then has no parent fallback).
189    * @param overridingParent The overriding parent bean store, consulted before local entries.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (no overriding parent is consulted).
190    */
191   public BasicBeanStore(BeanStore parent, BeanStore overridingParent) {
192      this.parent = parent;
193      this.overridingParent = overridingParent;
194      entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
195      addSupplier(BasicBeanStore.class, ()->this, null);
196      addSupplier(BeanStore.class, ()->this, null);
197      addSupplier(WritableBeanStore.class, ()->this, null);
198   }

256   /**
257    * Adds a supplier for an unnamed bean of the specified type to this store.
258    *
259    * <p>
260    * The supplier will be invoked lazily when the bean is first requested.
261    *
262    * @param <T> The class to associate this bean with.
263    * @param beanType The class to associate this bean with.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
264    * @param bean The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
265    * @return This object.

272   /**
273    * Adds a supplier for a named bean of the specified type to this store.
274    *
275    * <p>
276    * The supplier will be invoked lazily when the bean is first requested.
277    *
278    * @param <T> The class to associate this bean with.
279    * @param beanType The class to associate this bean with.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
280    * @param bean The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
281    * @param name The bean name if this is a named bean.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
282    * @return This object.
283    */
284   @Override
285   public <T> BasicBeanStore addSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> bean, String name) {
286      checkOpen();
287      var typeMap = entries.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
288      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
289      typeMap.put(key, bean);
290      putEntryMeta(beanType, key, BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT);
291      return this;
292   }

294   /**
295    * Adds a fallback supplier for an unnamed bean of the specified type to this store.
296    *
297    * <p>
298    * Default suppliers are consulted only after local {@linkplain #addBean(Class,Object) entries} and the regular
299    * {@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore) parent} have been searched.  They are intended for memoizer-backed
300    * framework defaults that should not shadow explicit user registrations or beans inherited from an
301    * {@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore,BeanStore) overriding parent} (e.g. Spring).
302    *
303    * @param <T> The bean type.
304    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
305    * @param supplier The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
306    * @return This object.
307    */
308   @Override
309   public <T> BasicBeanStore addDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> supplier) {
310      return addDefaultSupplier(beanType, supplier, null);
311   }

313   /**
314    * Adds a fallback supplier for a named bean of the specified type to this store.
315    *
316    * <p>
317    * See {@link #addDefaultSupplier(Class,Supplier)} for ordering semantics.
318    *
319    * @param <T> The bean type.
320    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
321    * @param supplier The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
322    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
323    * @return This object.
324    */
325   @Override
326   public <T> BasicBeanStore addDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> supplier, String name) {
327      checkOpen();
328      var typeMap = extras().defaults.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
329      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
330      typeMap.put(key, supplier);
331      return this;
332   }

334   /**
335    * Promotes every locally-registered default supplier to a local entry supplier of the same name and type.
336    *
337    * <p>
338    * Default suppliers normally resolve at tier 4 (after the regular parent walk), which means a parent
339    * store's default supplier wins over this store's default supplier when both are registered for the same
340    * type.  Promoting moves each default into the tier-2 local-entry slot so that this store's framework
341    * defaults take precedence over the parent's same-type defaults &mdash; useful for embedded sub-contexts
342    * (e.g. per-mixin {@code RestContext}s) that need their own framework objects (serializer set, parser set,
343    * call logger, etc.) even though the parent is parent-linked for non-framework bean lookups.
344    *
345    * <p>
346    * The original default-supplier registrations are left in place; promoted entries that already exist as
347    * local entries are not overwritten.  Promotion is idempotent and only affects suppliers registered prior
348    * to the call &mdash; later {@code addDefaultSupplier(...)} calls do not retroactively promote.
349    *
350    * @return This object.
351    * @since 10.0.0
352    */
353   public BasicBeanStore promoteDefaultsToLocalSuppliers() {
354      checkOpen();
355      var x = extras.get();
356      if (x != null)
357         x.defaults.forEach((beanType, typeMap) -> typeMap.forEach((name, supplier) ->
358            entries.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).putIfAbsent(name, supplier)));
359      return this;
360   }
361
362   @Override
363   public Snapshot pushOverlay(BeanStore overlay) {
364      Objects.requireNonNull(overlay, "overlay must not be null");
365      checkOpen();
366      var stack = overlayStack.get();
367      if (stack == null) {
368         synchronized (this) {
369            stack = overlayStack.get();
370            if (stack == null) {
371               stack = new StackOverlay();
372               overlayStack.set(stack);
373            }
374         }
375      }
376      stack.push(overlay);
377      return new Snapshot(this, overlay);
378   }
379
380   @Override
381   public void popOverlay(Snapshot snapshot) {
382      Objects.requireNonNull(snapshot, "snapshot must not be null");
383      checkOpen();
384      if (snapshot.owner() != this)
385         throw new IllegalStateException("Snapshot does not belong to this BeanStore (foreign-snapshot pop).");
386      var stack = overlayStack.get();
387      if (stack == null || stack.depth() == 0)
388         throw new IllegalStateException("popOverlay invoked on an empty overlay stack.");
389      // LIFO discipline — the snapshot must identify the current top-of-stack frame.
390      var top = stack.peek();
391      if (top != snapshot.frame())
392         throw new IllegalStateException(
393            "Out-of-order popOverlay: supplied snapshot does not identify the top-of-stack overlay frame.");
394      stack.pop();
395   }

397   /**
398    * Removes all beans from this store.
399    *
400    * <p>
401    * This operation only affects this store and does not affect the parent bean store.
402    *
403    * @return This object.
404    */
405   @Override
406   public BasicBeanStore clear() {
407      checkOpen();
408      entries.clear();
409      var x = extras.get();
410      if (x != null) {
411         x.defaults.clear();
412         x.entryMetadata.clear();
413         x.registeredConfigurations.clear();
414      }
415      return this;
416   }

426    * @return The bean, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not found.

434   /**
435    * Returns the named bean of the specified type.
436    *
437    * <p>
438    * If no bean with the specified name is found in this store, searches the parent store recursively.
439    *
440    * @param <T> The type of bean to return.
441    * @param beanType The type of bean to return.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
442    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
443    * @return The bean, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not found.
444    */
445   @Override
446   public <T> Optional<T> getBean(Class<T> beanType, String name) {
447      checkOpen();
448      if (name == null) {
449         var unnamed = resolve(beanType, null).map(Supplier::get);
450         if (unnamed.isPresent())
451            return unnamed.map(this::trackResolved);
452         return selectPrimary(beanType).map(this::trackResolved);
453      }
454      return resolve(beanType, name).map(Supplier::get).map(this::trackResolved);
455   }
456
457   /**
458    * Returns all beans of the specified type, keyed by bean name.
459    *
460    * <p>
461    * The map keys are the bean names (empty string for unnamed beans), and the values are the bean instances.
462    * Results from the parent store are included first, then beans from this store (which override parent beans with the same name).
463    *
464    * @param <T> The bean type.
465    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
466    * @return A map of bean names to bean instances.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
467    */
468   @Override
469   public <T> Map<String,T> getBeansOfType(Class<T> beanType) {
470      checkOpen();
471      // Build the result respecting the priority order used by getBean / resolve:
472      //   defaults (lowest) < parent < entries (local) < overridingParent < overlayStack (highest)
473      // Higher-priority maps overwrite lower-priority ones with the same name.
474      Map<String,T> result = map();
475      var defaultMap = defaultTypeMap(beanType);
476      if (nn(defaultMap))
477         defaultMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> result.put(name, (T)supplier.get()));
478      if (nn(parent))
479         parent.getBeansOfType(beanType).forEach(result::put);
480      var typeMap = entries.get(beanType);
481      if (nn(typeMap))
482         typeMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> result.put(name, (T)supplier.get()));
483      if (nn(overridingParent))
484         overridingParent.getBeansOfType(beanType).forEach(result::put);
485      var stack = overlayStack.get();
486      if (nn(stack) && stack.depth() > 0)
487         stack.getBeansOfType(beanType).forEach(result::put);
488      if (result.isEmpty())
489         return result;
490      return result.entrySet().stream()
491         .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(e -> beanOrder(beanType, e.getKey())))
492         .collect(LinkedHashMap::new, (m, e) -> m.put(e.getKey(), trackResolved(e.getValue())), Map::putAll);
493   }

525   /**

527    *
528    * <p>

530    * unwrapped from any resolution chain &mdash; it lets callers promote a memoizer-backed default
531    * supplier into a higher-precedence layer (e.g. a local entry) without re-invoking the underlying
532    * factory.
533    *
534    * @param <T> The bean type.

536    * @return The locally-registered default supplier, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not present.

542   /**
543    * Returns the default supplier registered locally for the specified bean type and name, or empty if none.
544    *
545    * <p>
546    * Parent and overriding-parent stores are <i>not</i> consulted.  This returns the supplier itself,
547    * unwrapped from any resolution chain &mdash; it lets callers promote a memoizer-backed default
548    * supplier into a higher-precedence layer (e.g. a local entry) without re-invoking the underlying
549    * factory.
550    *
551    * @param <T> The bean type.
552    * @param beanType The bean type to look up.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
553    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
554    * @return The locally-registered default supplier, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not present.
555    */
556   public <T> Optional<Supplier<T>> getDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType, String name) {
557      var typeMap = defaultTypeMap(beanType);
558      if (typeMap == null)
559         return oe();
560      var supplier = typeMap.get(emptyIfNull(name));
561      return supplier == null ? oe() : o((Supplier<T>) supplier);
562   }

564   /**

626   /**
627    * Resolves a supplier for a bean of the specified type and name.
628    *
629    * <p>
630    * If no supplier with the specified name is found in this store, searches the parent store recursively.
631    *
632    * @param <T> The bean type.
633    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
634    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
635    * @return The supplier, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no supplier of the specified type and name exists.
636    */
637   protected <T> Optional<Supplier<T>> resolve(Class<T> beanType, String name) {
638      // (0) Push/pop overlay stack — wins over the construction-time overridingParent slot because pushed
639      // frames are "more recent".  Lazily initialized; null until the first pushOverlay() call.
640      var stack = overlayStack.get();
641      if (nn(stack) && stack.depth() > 0) {
642         var fromStack = stack.getBeanSupplier(beanType, name);
643         if (fromStack.isPresent())
644            return fromStack;
645      }
646      // (1) Overriding parent (e.g. Spring) — wins over local entries.
647      if (nn(overridingParent)) {
648         var fromOverriding = overridingParent.getBeanSupplier(beanType, name);
649         if (fromOverriding.isPresent())
650            return fromOverriding;
651      }
652      // (2) Local regular entries.
653      var typeMap = entries.get(beanType);
654      if (nn(typeMap)) {
655         var key = emptyIfNull(name);
656         var supplier = typeMap.get(key);
657         if (nn(supplier))
658            return o((Supplier<T>)supplier);
659      }
660      // (3) Regular parent fallback.
661      if (nn(parent)) {
662         var fromParent = parent.getBeanSupplier(beanType, name);
663         if (fromParent.isPresent())
664            return fromParent;
665      }
666      // (4) Local default suppliers (memoizer-backed framework defaults).
667      var defaultMap = defaultTypeMap(beanType);
668      if (nn(defaultMap)) {
669         var key = emptyIfNull(name);
670         var supplier = defaultMap.get(key);
671         if (nn(supplier))
672            return o((Supplier<T>)supplier);
673      }
674      return oe();
675   }

703   /**
704    * Finds and invokes a factory method that produces a bean of type <c>beanType</c>.
705    *
706    * <p>
707    * If <c>onClassOrObject</c> is a {@link Class}, only static methods are eligible.
708    * Otherwise, both instance and static methods on the object's class are eligible.
709    * A <jk>null</jk> <c>filter</c> accepts any qualifying method.
710    *
711    * <p>
712    * The search has two passes.  The first pass considers public methods only (unchanged behavior).  If it finds
713    * nothing, the second pass considers <em>non-public</em> methods across the class hierarchy, child class first,
714    * but only those carrying {@link Bean @Bean} (declared directly or inherited from a method they override; see
715    * {@link BeanAnnotation#find(MethodInfo)}).  Bridge/synthetic methods, interface static methods and deprecated
716    * methods are skipped, as are parent methods overridden by an already-seen child method.  A non-public method
717    * without {@link Bean @Bean} is never invoked, even when <c>filter</c> is <jk>null</jk>.
718    * Non-public methods are made accessible before invocation.
719    *
720    * <h4 class='section'>Example:</h4>
721    * <p class='bjava'>
722    *    <jk>public class</jk> MyResource {
723    *       <ja>@Bean</ja>
724    *       RichLogger logger() { <jk>return new</jk> RichLogger(); }  <jc>// Package-private, found by the second pass.</jc>
725    *    }
726    *
727    *    Optional&lt;RichLogger&gt; <jv>logger</jv> = <jv>beanStore</jv>.createBeanFromMethod(RichLogger.<jk>class</jk>, <jk>new</jk> MyResource());
728    * </p>
729    *
730    * @param <T> The bean type.
731    * @param beanType The type of bean to create.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
732    * @param onClassOrObject The object instance or {@link Class} whose methods are searched.
733    *    Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
734    * @param filter Optional predicate restricting which methods are eligible.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (any method qualifies).
735    * @param extraBeans Optional bean instances visible to parameter resolution for this call only.
736    * @return The created bean wrapped in an {@link Optional}, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no matching
737    *    factory method was found.
738    * @throws BeanCreationException If a matching method was found but threw an exception during invocation.
739    */
740   @Override
741   public <T> Optional<T> createBeanFromMethod(Class<T> beanType, Object onClassOrObject, Predicate<MethodInfo> filter, Object... extraBeans) {
742      reqnn("beanType", beanType);
743      reqnn("onClassOrObject", onClassOrObject);
744      Object resource = onClassOrObject instanceof Class ? null : onClassOrObject;
745      Class<?> resourceClass = onClassOrObject instanceof Class<?> onClassOrObject2 ? onClassOrObject2 : onClassOrObject.getClass();
746      var first = info(resourceClass)
747         .getPublicMethod(m ->
748            m.isNotDeprecated()
749            && m.hasReturnType(beanType)
750            && (filter == null || filter.test(m))
751            && (m.isStatic() || nn(resource))
752            && m.canResolveAllParameters(this, extraBeans))
753         .map(m -> {
754            try {
755               return m.<T>inject(this, resource, extraBeans);
756            } catch (Exception e) {
757               throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to create bean of type [" + beanType.getSimpleName() + "] via method [" + m.getName() + "]", e);
758            }
759         });
760      if (first.isPresent())
761         return first;
762      return createBeanFromNonPublicMethod(beanType, resourceClass, resource, filter, extraBeans);
763   }

765   /**
766    * Second pass of {@link #createBeanFromMethod}: non-public {@link Bean @Bean}-annotated methods, child class first.
767    */
768   private <T> Optional<T> createBeanFromNonPublicMethod(Class<T> beanType, Class<?> resourceClass, Object resource, Predicate<MethodInfo> filter, Object[] extraBeans) {
769      var seen = new HashSet<String>();  // Signatures of non-private, non-static methods already visited (child-first).
770      for (var m : info(resourceClass).getAllMethods()) {
771         if (m.isBridge() || m.isSynthetic())
772            continue;
773         if (m.isNotPrivate() && m.isNotStatic() && ! seen.add(m.getSignature()))
774            continue;
775         if (m.isPublic() || (m.isStatic() && m.getDeclaringClass().isInterface()))
776            continue;
777         if (BeanAnnotation.find(m).isEmpty())
778            continue;
779         if (m.isNotDeprecated()
780            && m.hasReturnType(beanType)
781            && (filter == null || filter.test(m))
782            && (m.isStatic() || nn(resource))
783            && m.canResolveAllParameters(this, extraBeans))
784            return Optional.ofNullable(BeanMethodInvoker.invoke(this, beanType, m, m.isStatic() ? null : resource, extraBeans));
785      }
786      return Optional.empty();
787   }

827   @Override
828   public void close() throws BeanCreationException {
829      if (! closed.compareAndSet(false, true))
830         return;
831      var errors = new BeanCreationException("Errors while invoking @PreDestroy callbacks.");
832      boolean hasErrors = false;
833      var t = tracking.get();
834      List<Object> beans = new ArrayList<>();
835      if (t != null)
836         synchronized (t) {
837            beans.addAll(t.beans);
838         }
839      Collections.reverse(beans);
840      for (var bean : beans) {
841         for (var method : ClassInfo.of(bean).getAllMethods()) {
842            if (!method.getReturnType().is(void.class) || method.getParameterCount() != 0 || method.isAbstract() || method.isStatic())
843               continue;
844            if (method.getAnnotations().stream().noneMatch(JsrSupport::isPreDestroyAnnotation))
845               continue;
846            try {
847               method.invoke(bean);
848            } catch (Exception e) {
849               hasErrors = true;
850               errors.addSuppressed(e);
851            }
852         }
853      }
854      if (hasErrors)
855         throw errors;
856   }

858   private void registerConfiguration(Class<?> configType, Set<Class<?>> visited) {
859      if (!visited.add(configType))
860         return;
861      var cfg = configType.getAnnotation(Configuration.class);
862      if (cfg == null)
863         throw new BeanCreationException("Type is not @Configuration: " + configType.getName());
864      if (!matchesConditions(configType))
865         return;
866      // Annotation arrays cannot contain null elements at runtime — Java rejects null defaults at
867      // declaration time and the compiler refuses null literals in annotation values.  No defensive
868      // null check is needed here.
869      for (var imported : cfg.imports())
870         registerConfiguration(imported, visited);
871
872      // Walk the type and its superclasses; collect @Bean members on each level.  This honours
873      // the plan's "superclass inheritance of @Bean members" requirement.  Order matters here:
874      // process the highest ancestor first so subclass @Bean methods can depend on superclass
875      // beans (analogous to Spring's @Configuration inheritance).
876      Object instance = null;
877      var hierarchy = new ArrayList<Class<?>>();
878      for (var c = configType; c != null && c != Object.class; c = c.getSuperclass())
879         hierarchy.add(c);
880      Collections.reverse(hierarchy);
881      for (var c : hierarchy) {
882         for (var field : c.getDeclaredFields()) {
883            var beanAnn = field.getAnnotation(Bean.class);
884            if (beanAnn == null)
885               continue;
886            if (!matchesConditions(field))
887               continue;
888            try {
889               if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers()) && instance == null)
890                  instance = BeanInstantiator.of(configType, this).run();
891               field.setAccessible(true);
892               var value = field.get(java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers()) ? null : instance);
893               addBeanWithMeta((Class<Object>)field.getType(), value, emptyIfNull(beanName(beanAnn)), BeanSourceMeta.from(field, beanAnn));
894            } catch (Exception e) {
895               throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to register @Bean field: " + field, e);
896            }
897         }
898         // Class.getDeclaredMethods() has no defined order, so a @Bean method that depends on a bean produced by
899         // another @Bean method of the same class may be reached first.  Methods whose parameters cannot be
900         // resolved yet are deferred and retried until a pass makes no progress.
901         var pending = new ArrayList<java.lang.reflect.Method>();
902         for (var method : c.getDeclaredMethods()) {
903            var beanAnn = method.getAnnotation(Bean.class);
904            if (beanAnn == null)
905               continue;
906            if (!matchesConditions(method))
907               continue;
908            pending.add(method);
909         }
910         while (! pending.isEmpty()) {
911            var deferred = new ArrayList<java.lang.reflect.Method>();
912            Exception firstUnresolved = null;
913            for (var method : pending) {
914               var beanAnn = method.getAnnotation(Bean.class);
915               try {
916                  if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(method.getModifiers()) && instance == null)
917                     instance = BeanInstantiator.of(configType, this).run();
918                  method.setAccessible(true);
919                  var value = MethodInfo.of(method).inject(this, java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(method.getModifiers()) ? null : instance);
920                  addBeanWithMeta((Class<Object>)method.getReturnType(), value, emptyIfNull(beanName(beanAnn)), BeanSourceMeta.from(method, beanAnn));
921               } catch (ExecutableException e) {
922                  if (e.getCause() != null || e.getMessage() == null || ! e.getMessage().startsWith("Could not resolve value for parameter"))
923                     throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to register @Bean method: " + method, e);
924                  if (firstUnresolved == null)
925                     firstUnresolved = new BeanCreationException("Failed to register @Bean method: " + method, e);
926                  deferred.add(method);
927               } catch (Exception e) {
928                  throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to register @Bean method: " + method, e);
929               }
930            }
931            if (deferred.size() == pending.size())
932               throw (BeanCreationException)firstUnresolved;
933            pending = deferred;
934         }
935      }
936   }

938   private boolean matchesConditions(java.lang.reflect.AnnotatedElement element) {
939      var classLoader = element instanceof Class<?> element2 ? element2.getClassLoader() : element.getClass().getClassLoader();
940      var ctx = new ConditionContext(this, Settings.get(), classLoader, element);
941      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(Conditional.class)) {
942         if (!BeanInstantiator.of(c.value(), this).run().matches(ctx)) {
943            LOGGER.fine(() -> "Skipping conditional element due to @Conditional: " + element);
944            return false;
945         }
946      }
947      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(ConditionalOnClass.class)) {
948         try {
949            Class.forName(c.value(), false, classLoader);
950         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") ClassNotFoundException e) {
951            LOGGER.fine(() -> "Skipping conditional element due to missing class " + c.value() + ": " + element);
952            return false;
953         }
954      }
955      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(ConditionalOnMissingBean.class)) {
956         var type = c.value();
957         var name = c.name().isEmpty() ? null : c.name();
958         if (type == Object.class) {
959            if (name != null && anyLocalBeanNamed(name))
960               return false;
961         } else if (hasBean(type, name)) {
962            return false;
963         }
964      }
965      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(ConditionalOnProperty.class)) {
966         var value = Settings.get().get(c.name()).orElse(null);
967         if (value == null && !c.matchIfMissing())
968            return false;
969         if (value != null && !c.havingValue().isEmpty() && !c.havingValue().equals(value))
970            return false;
971      }
972      return true;
973   }

986   private <T> void addBeanWithMeta(Class<T> beanType, T bean, String name, BeanSourceMeta meta) {
987      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
988      // Duplicate-check against LOCAL entries only.  Beans present via the overridingParent or parent
989      // chain are allowed to coexist with a local registration here — the resolution order
990      // (overridingParent > local > parent > defaults) ensures the right entry wins at lookup time.
991      // This is what lets a test-time overlay installed in the overridingParent slot coexist with a
992      // local @Bean factory of the same (type, name) declared on a @Configuration class without
993      // triggering a spurious duplicate-bean error.
994      var typeMap = entries.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
995      if (typeMap.containsKey(key))
996         throw new BeanCreationException("Duplicate bean: type=" + beanType.getName() + ", name=" + key);
997      typeMap.put(key, () -> bean);
998      putEntryMeta(beanType, key, meta);
999   }

1001   private <T> T trackResolved(T bean) {
1002      if (bean == null)
1003         return null;
1004      var t = tracking.get();

1006         synchronized (this) {
1007            t = tracking.get();
1008            if (t == null) {
1009               t = new Tracking();
1010               tracking.set(t);
1011            }
1012         }
1013      }
1014      synchronized (t) {
1015         if (t.identities.add(bean))
1016            t.beans.add(bean);
1017      }
1018      return bean;
1019   }
